title: Aromatic Greek Chicken Avgolemono
description: A comforting and aromatic Greek dish featuring chicken, wholegrain mustard, and a silky avgolemono sauce, served in a lacquerware bowl.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chicken to the saucepan and cook until browned on all sides and cooked through.
Remove the chicken from the saucepan and set aside.
Add the garlic, thyme, salt, and pepper to the saucepan and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Whisk together the lemon juice and egg yolks in a small bowl.
Gradually add the hot chicken broth to the lemon juice mixture, whisking constantly.
Return the saucepan to medium heat and add the wholegrain mustard and whisk until smooth.
Add the cooked chicken back to the saucepan and simmer for 2 minutes.
